      "body": "Thanks for your reply. I understand we might need conversion if the db field type is different with the entity property type.       "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "@ajcvickers, sorry I can't share the full code with you as it's part of company application. The code is quite straight forward. \r\n\r\n1. Have a field PostCode as nvarchar in database table Member. The only thing it might have impact is we use encryption\r\n   [PostCode] [nvarchar](50) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN2 ENCRYPTED WITH (COLUMN_ENCRYPTION_KEY = [PIIColumnEncryptionKey], ENCRYPTION_TYPE = Deterministic, ALGORITHM = 'AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_256') NULL,\r\n2. Have a entity model Member with a property PostCode as string. This is generated by using dotnet-ef\r\n    public string PostCode { get; set; }\r\n3. Call DbContext.Member.Where(m => m.Id = 1000).FirstOrDefault()\r\n4. Get the above exception\r\n\r\nIt might be related to the encryption however we don't have the problem with EF 6."
    },

      "body": "@jasondaicoder is your application targeting .NET Framework or .NET Core? Do you have `Column Encryption Setting=Enabled` in the connection string?\r\n"

      "id": 314605731,
      "url": "https://github.com/dotnet/efcore/issues/9142#issuecomment-314605731",
      "created_at": "2017-07-12T00:03:47Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "External issue https://github.com/dotnet/corefx/issues/18276\r\n\r\n@jasondaicoder - This is not EF Core bug. The underlying SqlClient in .NET core does not support `column encryption setting`. Since the setting is not enabled, while fetching records from server, EF receives encrypted value of byte[] type which cannot be assigned to string property hence it threw exception.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 314606820,
      "url": "https://github.com/dotnet/efcore/issues/9142#issuecomment-314606820",
      "created_at": "2017-07-12T00:10:09Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "@smitpatel, thanks for the information. Looks like we found the culprit. Looks like we will need to wait for 2.0 :("
    },
    {
      "id": 314617158,
      "url": "https://github.com/dotnet/efcore/issues/9142#issuecomment-314617158",
      "created_at": "2017-07-12T01:21:23Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@jasondaicoder unfortunately I think you are going to have to wait until later after. The feature needs to be prioritized for SqlClient as @corivera indicated at https://github.com/dotnet/corefx/issues/18276#issuecomment-314610769 and it won't be supported in 2.0."
    }
